title: carex rigida subsp. intricata
intro: Carex rigida subsp. intricata, commonly known as Rough Sedge, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body from various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Carex rigida subsp. intricata include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activities, and act as a diuretic, making it a useful treatment for conditions such as urinary tract infections and kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
